profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft Azure HPC/AI | Master’s in Computer Science @ University of Washington | Canadian Permanent Resident
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer II at Microsoft with experience building scalable software systems, AI-powered applications, and cloud infrastructure. Previously, I worked at Google, Meta, and Uber, contributing to products and engineering systems used at scale.

My work spans AI infrastructure, LLM applications, distributed systems, and backend engineering. I've architected GPU-based inference platforms, built LLM-powered agents for automated incident resolution, developed secure AI platform services, and designed observability and automation solutions for production environments.

I enjoy tackling complex engineering challenges, from designing reliable distributed systems to turning emerging AI technologies into practical, production-ready solutions. My technical experience includes Python, C++, Kubernetes, Azure, and LLM technologies such as RAG and inference frameworks.

I'm passionate about building impactful technology, continuously learning, and collaborating with teams to solve challenging problems at scale!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led the development of secure AI platform infrastructure, agentic automation workflows, and standardized telemetry systems, improving access control, operational efficiency, and observability across distributed services.
- Architected and implemented identity-based authentication and fine-grained access control for an LLM platform, eliminating shared identities and enabling secure, token-based access for AI agents. Led the migration strategy and implementation across infrastructure, SDKs, and orchestration services using Python and C#, while maintaining backward compatibility.
- Developed an AI-powered security vulnerability triage workflow to analyze vulnerabilities, recommend remediation steps, and generate stakeholder-ready summaries. Established the workflow as a standard operational process, reducing turnaround time.
- Designed and implemented a governed telemetry SDK using Python, OpenTelemetry, and Azure data services, standardizing metrics, logs, and lifecycle events across distributed services to improve observability, accelerate debugging, and decouple applications from underlying telemetry infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Designed and deployed scalable AI inference infrastructure on Azure to support large language models, with a focus on performance monitoring, GPU utilization, and automated infrastructure provisioning.
- Architected a multi-node GPU inference platform on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), leveraging FastChat and SGLang to support scalable LLM serving in a production environment.
- Established an observability framework using Prometheus, Grafana, and NVIDIA DCGM to monitor GPU utilization, inference latency, throughput, cache efficiency, and platform health.
- Automated infrastructure provisioning and deployment using Bicep, PowerShell, and shell scripting, enabling repeatable deployments across multiple environments, including Kubernetes clusters, GPU resources, storage, monitoring, and networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built AI infrastructure and LLM-powered solutions for HPC/AI operations, focusing on automated incident resolution, knowledge retrieval, and model training.
- Led the development of an LLM-powered incident resolution agent using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to support automated diagnosis and troubleshooting of complex HPC/AI incidents.
- Developed data pipelines to prepare pre-training and supervised fine-tuning datasets from technical documentation, incorporating data collection, cleansing, image-to-text transcription, and LLM-assisted content refinement.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved Google Search filter functionality by modernizing a globally available feature and simplifying its integration across internal teams.
- Migrated Google Search filter buttons to a generic interface, simplifying the codebase and streamlining integration for 20+ internal clients across C++, Java, and TypeScript.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved data collection and measurement reliability for A/B testing on Google Search by developing logging infrastructure and reusable software components.
- Developed two C++ loggers to enhance data collection for Google Search A/B tests, improve experiment metrics, and reduce experimental noise.
- Designed and implemented a reusable shared library to centralize common logging functionality, reduce code duplication, and improve maintainability.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and improved a Meta advertiser-support chatbot connecting advertisers with ads consultants, enhancing maintainability, system reliability, and user feedback collection.
- Simplified the chatbot’s decision tree using Hack, reducing the number of nodes by 61% and improving code readability and maintainability.
- Migrated the chatbot from legacy infrastructure to a new system, implementing 23 Hack classes with comprehensive unit tests to improve reliability and maintainability.
- Scoped, planned, and implemented a post-conversation survey, achieving 97% response adherence and gathering feedback to evaluate the user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved Uber driver safety systems by integrating safety data platforms and analyzing incident trends to support data-driven safety decisions.
- Developed Kafka consumers in Go to enable reliable ingestion and cross-platform access to driver safety data.
- Analyzed safety incident trends using SQL and Python (Pandas) to identify patterns in incident growth and inform safety initiatives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: São Paulo, São Paulo, Brazil · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a CI/CD pipeline for Trancity, a web-based platform for monitoring and analyzing urban mobility and infrastructure.
- Automated web application deployments using Jenkins and Shell scripting, reducing deployment time by 95% and eliminating repetitive manual processes.
- Implemented centralized logging and monitoring using the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) to improve system observability and streamline operational troubleshooting.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) · Shell script · Elastic Stack (ELK)
